title: Drafts that forgot their shape
hints: Hover `Draft<Shape>`, then `Draft<OfKind<Shape, "circle">>`. One member on its own is fine; it's the whole union that comes out wrong. Which helper does `Draft` lean on?

`Omit<T, K>` is a plain mapped type over `keyof T`, and `keyof` of a union only keeps the keys that **every** member shares. It never looks at the members one by one. `Patch` works because it splits the union first with `T extends unknown ? … : never`.
Make `Without` distribute: `type Without<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? Simplify<Omit<T, K>> : never;`
